summary: Iteration 6 — Shared-Leads feature parity round. Backend 12/12 pytest passing on new endpoints (POST /shared-leads/assign, POST /shared-leads/bulk-delete, GET /shared-leads/export/csv, sorted /shared-leads with name/city/plan/updated asc+desc, can_access_shared_pool gate, on_leaderboard toggle) and regression lock flow. Frontend UI verified: shared-select-all, shared-select-{id}, shared-bulk-bar, shared-bulk-agent, shared-bulk-transfer, shared-bulk-delete, shared-access-btn, shared-export, sort-name (asc/desc toggling verified with UIALPHA/UIBRAVO/UICHARLIE ordering), bob-sort-name/city/plan/effective/completed all visible & clickable, Agents edit modal exposes both edit-lb-switch AND edit-shared-switch. AgentAccessDialog opens and exposes access-switch-{id} rows. CSV response returns 200 with Content-Type text/csv, Content-Disposition attachment, header row containing 'Full Name,Phone Number,Birthdate,...'. Backend access gate returns {total:0, items:[]} for a gated agent (pytest-verified).

issues: Radix DialogContent emits console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}'. Not a blocker but should add a DialogDescription for a11y.

action_items: OPTIONAL a11y: Add <DialogDescription> to AgentAccessDialog and the Agents edit modal to silence the Radix aria-describedby warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1092 /shared-leads/assign correctly wipes history via _wipe_lead_history and resets status to Uncalled, effective_date=None, application_info=None, hra_info=None, appointment_at=None — matches /leads/assign semantics as advertised.
server.py:1122 /shared-leads/bulk-delete also purges related notes and call_logs and writes audit_logs. Good.
server.py:1171 access gate only returns {total:0, items:[]} for role=='agent'; owner is unaffected. Fine.
server.py:2122 backfill migration for can_access_shared_pool defaults to True — verified in users listing.

SharedLeads.jsx:227-229 the Address & Plan column headers do NOT have data-testids (only Name has sort-name). Review request only required sort-name, so acceptable, but consistency would be nice (sort-city, sort-plan).
SharedLeads.jsx name sort visually shows the '—' row (unnamed lead) at the top in name_asc and at the bottom in name_desc — expected for MongoDB natural sort of empty strings, not a bug.

server.py:1134 CSV export uses StreamingResponse with iter([csv_string]) — fine for small datasets, would ideally use an async generator to avoid buffering entire result in memory for large pools (>>20k rows). Non-critical for current scale.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all data-testids present, sorting/bulk-bar/access modal/export all verified in preview
